Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and our SOC 2 package checklist to help your security team scope the review. Quick recap and next steps below.

- Use case: multi-tenant SaaS feature personalization (user prompts + embeddings)
- Key requirements: PII minimization, KMS integration, VPC private deployment option for production
- Success criteria: latency < 200ms p50 for gen, SOC 2 Type II evidence for onboarding

Attached: Aurelia_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft) and SOC2_Package_Checklist.xlsx (evidence checklist).

   - Owner: Aurelia Tech security (Mike)

   - Dependency: confirmation of internal reviewer and primary contact
2) Questionnaire + evidence collection
   - Owner: Aurelia Tech (security + infra)
   - Target evidence delivery: 2026-06-30
3) Redwood SOC2 package delivery (answers + evidence links)
   - Owner: Redwood Security (Dev Patel)
   - Target: 2026-07-05
4) Final review & sign-off
   - Owner: Joint
   - Target close date: 2026-07-15

Ask: Can you confirm the Aurelia security reviewer(s) and whether the 6/30 evidence delivery date is feasible? If there are any additional compliance items your team needs (e.g., specific encryption proofs, audit logs), let us know and we'll prioritize.

Next steps from Redwood: we will prepare the detailed SOC 2 package (questionnaire responses, evidence bundle links) and share an S3/Drive folder for uploaded artifacts.

Thanks—looking forward to the next step.

Hi Mike / Jordan / team,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Attaching the SOC 2 questionnaire template and an evidence checklist (SOC2_Package_Checklist.xlsx) for reference. A few clarifications from Redwood Security:

- Questionnaire format: We prefer a combined doc (Q&A) and a corresponding evidence list with file name conventions so your infra team can drop artifacts into a shared folder.
- Evidence common asks (examples):
  * System architecture diagram (pdf/png)
  * KMS configuration screenshots + key rotation policy (pdf/export)
  * IAM user/role lists and recent access review report (csv/pdf)
  * Incident response policy + latest incident postmortem (pdf)
  * Retention policy + sample deletion logs (export)
  * SOC 2 certificate (if available) or auditor contact details

- Delivery: If Aurelia can place artifacts in a pre-shared Drive/S3 folder by 2026-06-30, Redwood will ingest and validate links by 2026-07-02 and produce the final SOC 2 package on 2026-07-05.
- Signed attestations: Not required for the initial package; we typically include system exports and signed statements only if the customer requests them or if legal requires.

I created a Drive folder for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D-SOC2-Aurelia (access by invite). Please confirm who on your side should get access and we'll share.

If helpful, we can run a 30-minute kickoff on 2026-06-20 to walk through the checklist and answer questions. Proposed time: 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
